decisions.name: 林慶台

decisions.reason: 2014 New Taipei flag ceremony shows several prominent faces; caption identifies 林慶台 but not an unambiguous single-face crop. Retain for person-specific face identification and manual crop; do not auto-approve.
decisions.rights: Commons CC BY-SA 3.0 metadata; source authorship not independently confirmed

decisions.name: 陳湘琪
decisions.sourceCaption: Chen Shiang-chyi at the 51st Golden Horse Awards in November 2014
decisions.author: CNA Taiwan - 中央社
decisions.reason: Actual source and 600x720 eyes/nose/mouth/chin/full pixels inspected: eyes open, mouth unobstructed, no second face, sufficiently recognizable, but face is left-of-center and crop can be improved. Commons attributes CNA Taiwan YouTube CC BY 3.0; original video's license has not been independently verified, and file page shows no explicit license-review bot. Hold release.
decisions.rights: CC BY 3.0 claimed by Commons from CNA YouTube video ffxdss7Xk6Y; independent source license verification pending

decisions.reason: Actual retained contact sheet shows an opera costume displayed on a stand, not the performer 李香琴. Caption describes clothing worn by the performer; no human face is present.

The director and main casts of The Doppelgänger

《紅娘的異想世界之在西廂》男女主角及導演林奕華，左起：劉若英、林奕華、王耀慶及周姮吟

decisions.name: 黃宏軒
decisions.sourceCaption: Processed with VSCO with al3pro preset
decisions.author: Petersuuu
decisions.reason: 2024-labelled studio portrait has dark, small face and weak eye detail in retained source sheet; automatic crop failed sharpness. Commons uploader claims own work CC BY 4.0, but EXIF explicitly states 'Copyright 2025. All rights reserved.' and uploader authorship is not independently established. Reject this exact game source; do not infer all other photos of the person are unusable.
decisions.rights: Commons CC BY 4.0 uploader claim conflicts with EXIF all-rights-reserved notice; independent rights holder verification missing
